caption: The drawing depicts a single drawstring bag centered on a plain, off-white background. The bag features a gathered, ruched top section rendered in a reddish-pink color, with two long, thin pink ribbons extending outward horizontally from either side for tying. The main body of the bag showcases a detailed, multicolored beaded design. The upper part of the bag is decorated with a band of green, yellow, and blue floral patterns. In the central area, there are more elaborate beadwork motifs, including large flowers in shades of blue, yellow, and red, as well as green leaves. Below this, near the bottom of the bag, a row of small houses and buildings is depicted in blue, yellow, green, and pink, with some trees and foliage interspersed. The lower edge of the bag is finished with a small, scalloped white trim. The overall shape of the bag is rectangular with a slightly rounded base. To the lower right of the bag, the name "Dolores A. Hanpt" is inscribed in red text.
title: Beaded Bag
